replacements.9: Abstract: A multiobjective crested porcupine optimization algorithm with principal-axis projection and a hypervolume double lock (MO-PACPO) is proposed to address search-step scaling, directional perturbations under stagnation, and uneven finite archives. Regular perturbations use the principal axes and absolute covariance scale of the nondominated archive. Objective-neighborhood guidance and sparse differential updates are combined with success-rate feedback. Hypervolume stagnation and low-variance directions jointly trigger projected pulses, while iterative local-area pruning maintains two-objective archives. Eight benchmark problems and dimensional optimization of a 2PPaPaR parallel mechanism are evaluated using 30 runs per configuration and 25,100 evaluations per run. Compared with two paper-derived MOCPO implementations, MO-PACPO achieves significantly better IGD on all eight problems and HV on seven. For the mechanism problem, enabling the conditional pulse increases mean HV by 0.199%, while the direction and trigger decomposition detects no significant independent gains. Area pruning wins on one and loses on four two-objective problems against crowding distance. Under the specified error assumptions and equal-weight TOPSIS rule, the selected design achieves an orientation-averaged translational workspace volume of 790,279 cm³, a first-order position RMS error of 0.2325 mm, and a global dexterity index of 0.2774.

methods: 为分离脉冲方向与触发条件的作用，设置低方差方向/随机方向与双条件/单条件的2×2对照，依次记为DL、DR、SL和SR，DL即Full。单条件保留HV停滞判据，取消低方差方向集非空这一门限；低方差集为空时，SL沿最小特征值对应方向施加脉冲。四组均保留父子成功率清零停滞计数的规则，其余搜索、边界处理和档案规则相同。随机方向在各自当代状态内逐个匹配投影样本的欧氏范数，再赋予独立球面方向；辅助随机流保持主随机流的抽样顺序，范数匹配在边界处理前完成。

同类多目标CPO对照采用文献[11]的式(6)—(9)、信息反馈式(11)及Algorithm 1复现，记为MOCPO-F/R。原文未定义多目标反馈的标量适应度，F采用固定归一化目标均值，R采用中间候选与所抽父代合并后的非支配等级。两版均采用固定种群100，四分支等概率，α=β=δ=0.5、γ=0.01；全局引导取第一非支配层随机个体，邻域取目标距离最近10个父代。以上为本文预设的复现解释，参数及公式对应关系见补充材料S7。中间候选与反馈候选各评价一次，完成125轮后达到25 100次评价，最终输出种群的非支配集。

方向与触发分析预设DL−DR、SL−SR、DL−SL、DR−SR及两方向效应之差，共五项配对比较；每问题、指标和积分设置分别进行Holm校正。MOCPO比较按每指标8问题×2版本校正，机构按两版本校正。均报告配对均值差、95%重采样区间及秩二列效应；完整检验与触发记录见补充材料S7。 95%均值区间逐项计算且未作多重校正，显著性按Holm校正后的符号秩检验判定。针对较多零差值，另以精确条件符号秩检验进行敏感性核验。
